description: The plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) of different fine-tuning methods for the Whisper model on a tiny dataset over six epochs. The x-axis represents the epoch, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 6, and tick labels at every integer value. The y-axis represents the WER, with a linear scale, ranging from 30 to 70, and tick labels at every 10 units. The plot displays five lines, each representing a different fine-tuning method: tiny AdaLoRA int4 (dark gray, circle markers, solid line), tiny AdaLoRA int8 (gray, square markers, solid line), tiny int4 (dark gray, circle markers, dashed line), tiny int8 (gray, square markers, dashed line), and tiny full (light gray, triangle markers, dotted line). The WER for tiny AdaLoRA int4 decreases from approximately 68 at epoch 0 to around 38 at epoch 6. Similarly, tiny AdaLoRA int8 starts at around 59 and ends at approximately 36, tiny int4 begins at about 69 and ends at around 39, and tiny int8 starts at approximately 50 and ends at around 37. The WER for tiny full remains relatively stable, starting at around 30 and ending at approximately 26, with a slight decrease over the epochs.
